project_context.design_philosophy: Information Clarity, Functional Beauty, De-cluttered, One Source of Truth

layout_architecture.global: Mobile-first, responsive bento grids. Strict hierarchy to replace the current 'wall of strips' layout.
sections_order: 1. Actionable Alerts: Stacked thin alert banners (Conditional rendering)
2. Core KPIs: The North Star metrics (4 cards)
3. Pipeline Engine: Unified Trials Card & Onboarding Funnel
5. System Health & Operations: Secondary Stats, Platform Issues, and NPS

AlertBanners.purpose: Group all urgent notifications (Failed payments, suspended orgs, Pro upgrades, GDPR archives) into top-level compact strips.

CoreKPIs.layout_spans: col-span-12 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4

UnifiedTrialsCard.purpose: Consolidate the duplicate Trial Funnel and Fresh Trials into a single cross-platform source of truth. Shift the perspective from 'Operations' to 'Cross-Platform'.

structure.header: Title 'Cross-Platform Trial Pipeline', subtitle clarifying platform-wide reach.
structure.top_row_kpis: Grid of 4 micro-stats: Active, Expiring < 7d (Amber highlight), Converted (30d), Conversion Rate (%).
structure.body_left: Module Breakdown: A visual breakdown (horizontal bars or styled list) showing active trials split by module (Operations, Memberships, CRM, Marketing).
structure.body_right: Fresh Trials List: Max 5 recent items showing Name, Team Size, Module Tag, and Time-ago.
structure.footer: Full-width or right-aligned primary CTA button 'Manage All Trials' linking to the deep-dive Trials section.

PlatformGrowthSection.content: Line chart (Recharts) showing users + orgs over months.

components: SecondaryStatsGrid: AI Calls, Equip Tracked, Failed Payments metric, Resolved Cases (col-span-1)

implementation_notes.styling: Use pure Tailwind CSS. Preserve existing `Panel` aesthetic verbatim (bg-white, slate text, specific border radii/shadows). Do not introduce new themes.
implementation_notes.mobile_responsiveness: Ensure no horizontal overflow. Grid items must stack `grid-cols-1` on mobile. Use `overflow-x-auto` strictly inside chart containers if necessary.
implementation_notes.recharts: Ensure `ResponsiveContainer` is used for all charts to prevent layout breaks on small screens.
